scope: Minimum original persisted E2 ExitRequest to E5 EXIT-only management join; design only, not implementation or complete H01.

reviewed_refinement.source: Root message in this review task; supplements unchanged captured design file.
reviewed_refinement.anchor: Persist original entry decision commitment, earliest authentic positive canonical projection with matching lifecycle binding and actual earliest original-entry fill clock; use existing anchor codec.
reviewed_refinement.decision: Persist exact current source/binding, original plan/request/anchor, explicit market input and original interpreter/action clocks. Pure interpreter replay only validates historical bytes, without renewing authority.
reviewed_refinement.consumer: Private common consumer receives exact journal-loaded decision/type and durable-row equality; preserves public generic prepare_close behavior and current E4/E6/E7 gates.

supported_conclusions.conclusion: Existing anchor construction/codec support original request/plan/first-fill/hold binding. Selecting the earliest actual positive projection is necessary because initial reference uses that projection average; choosing a later partial/full average would change the original anchor.

A private consumer of the exact E5 action is the required narrow seam: existing prepare_close otherwise generates a new generic action. Existing canonical E5 and E4 close validators can retain exact source/lineage/quantity/reasons and original action expiry.

Direct claimed-operation reconciliation is required before current interpretation/translation/expiry gates. execute requires a live translated preparation, and prepare_close_order stamps a new request clock; neither belongs on the original claimed retry path.

implementation_constraints.constraint: Accept only status AUTHORIZED with exact action EXIT and lifecycle_intent EXIT_REQUESTED. Do not treat every AUTHORIZED outcome as an EXIT: current interpreter also produces PROTECT for an unprotected position.

Keep the new owner and fixture applicability creation explicitly FIXTURE/FAKE-provider scoped. A journal row or successful historical pure replay grants no current permission; normal MANAGE_EXISTING, actual current source, native read/metadata/proofs and final operation guard remain required before a new claim/POST.

Pure historical replay must use retained original source/anchor/market/now/action expiry and compare exact outcome/action; it must not replace original clocks with current time, allocate a permit, or run before direct reconciliation of a claimed close.

Saved but unclaimed decisions remain fail-closed on changed source, expired action or lost original preparation. Do not call generic prepare_close on such a retry or silently create a renewed action/request under the same stable operation.

limits: No source/test/Git changes or tests, compilation, imports, DB, process, native, network or provider operations performed. Only this new outside-Git review artifact is written.
No implementation correctness, execution result, native support, real provider applicability, financial activation, H01 completion, PQR or Master acceptance is established.
The refinement is reviewed as the stated intended implementation; no code implementing it existed in this review scope.
